profile.tagline: I operate production infrastructure and automate the path from git to running systems — AWS, Linux, CI/CD, and reliable deployments.

about.intro: DevOps Engineer serving as the sole deployment and infrastructure engineer for a software company's flagship product — a government-focused eHRMS platform (attendance, leave, and payroll) — live across 15+ client environments, alongside 250+ client websites.
about.focus: I built deployment automation that cut server setup from hours to minutes, introduced CI/CD where none existed, and independently diagnosed and resolved a recurring production database failure. AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, currently pursuing AWS Solutions Architect Associate.
points: Sole deployment engineer for a live eHRMS platform across 15+ client environments
250+ client websites, 15 Ubuntu servers, and 200+ domains under operational ownership
Deployment time reduced from 2–3 hours to approximately 30 minutes
GitLab CI/CD, production alerting, automated backups, and incident response

profile.contactNote: If you need someone who can own servers, pipelines, and production incidents — not just talk about them — let's talk.

experience.description: Sole deployment and infrastructure engineer for the company's flagship government-focused eHRMS platform (attendance, leave, and payroll), alongside a large client web hosting estate.
achievements: Serve as the sole deployment engineer for an eHRMS platform live across 15+ client environments, alongside 250+ client websites

Built a Bash automation script that reduced full application deployment — domain mapping, Nginx/Apache virtual host configuration, directory setup, Git and database configuration — from 2–3 hours to approximately 30 minutes
Introduced GitLab CI/CD for the development environment where none previously existed, letting developers push code directly to automatic deployment
Diagnosed a recurring MySQL crash that repeatedly took the development server offline by isolating a corrupted database table; backed up and migrated the data to a new table
Built a production alerting system using Microsoft Teams and email webhooks, closing a gap where no server alerting had previously existed

Manage 15 Ubuntu servers and 200+ client domains — DNS, Cloudflare (DNS, security, VPN), and cPanel deployments across Hostinger and Bigrock — with automated database backups to local storage and AWS S3

experience.description: Hands-on AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, and cloud operations applied to simulated production workloads.
achievements: Designed and deployed a scalable AWS cloud architecture (EC2, S3, RDS) with Auto Scaling groups and Elastic Load Balancers
Built CI/CD automation using AWS CodePipeline/CodeBuild and serverless workflows with Lambda/DynamoDB
Configured VPC networking, security groups, and IAM policies per AWS security best practices

experience.description: Level-1/Level-2 hardware, networking, and software support, including server backups and device health monitoring.
achievements: Resolved approximately 60 hardware, networking, and software tickets weekly (Level-1/Level-2)
Provided direct, non-ticketed support to senior leadership across departments
Ran server backups, antivirus monitoring, and device health checks
